executive_summary: In the last 30 days the account spent $12,573.30 for 4,635 clicks and 171 conversions, a $73.53 CPA against the $80 target.
Over the last 12 full months spend grew from $6,420.15 (2025-10) to $12,240.10 (2026-09) and CPA fell from $85.60 to $73.74; October is on the same pace at $11,309.00 month to date.
Fix first: send the Clinics | Search | US, CA, UK ads to the clinics page and move the campaign off Maximize Clicks, which spends $1,152.80 a month beyond the target.
trend_note: October is 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-27, month to date. CPA is spend divided by conversions.
